resources.string: The Control Center, picture diagnostics and the gaming HUD over any app or console. Hold Home for the Control Center (sound, Wi-Fi, profiles, sleep timer, power). Hold Up and Down together for 2 seconds for the picture, Left and Right for the HUD. It watches the remote\'s buttons and which app is in front. It reads the screen only on the TV\'s own Bluetooth and Wi-Fi pages, to press a device or network you picked in the Control Center. Now and then it keeps a small picture of the app in front, for that app\'s card in the app switcher (press Home twice); the pictures stay on the TV.
Presses Connect on the TV\'s Bluetooth page when you connect a device from Neon Home, then turns itself off.
A crash report has been sent to help us fix this issue.
